prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

item.text: I’ll trace the resolver and ClientConn error paths, then add the smallest API and behavior change that lets resolvers report resolution failures to failfast RPCs.

item.text: The current balancer API drops resolver errors, and the picker blocks when it has no usable connection. I’ll add `resolver.ClientConn.ReportError` and have the picker return that error for failfast calls while wait-for-ready calls continue waiting for a new resolver update.

The API is in place, with the manual resolver forwarding the new callback. I also updated the resolver test doubles so the interface change remains source-compatible within this repository. I’m checking formatting and the final diff now; I won’t run tests unless requested.

item.text:
Added `resolver.ClientConn.ReportError(error)`. Reported errors now fail failfast RPCs with `Unavailable` and the resolver error in the message; wait-for-ready RPCs keep waiting until a new state or address update arrives. The manual resolver forwards the new callback.

Updated resolver test doubles for the interface change. `gofmt` and `git diff --check` completed; tests were not run.
